about_the_game:
Relaxing Farm: Merge Tales is a cozy, card-based farming and merging game where you build your dream farm one card at a time.

🌱 Drag, Merge, and Grow
Plant seeds, raise animals, and combine ingredients by simply dragging and stacking cards. Watch your farm expand as you create everything from wheat and eggs to cheese, hotpots, and honey roast duck.

💰 Farm, Sell, and Profit
Harvest fresh produce, sell it at the market for coins, or merge it into high-value products to maximize your profits.

📦 Order-Driven Gameplay
Complete customer orders to earn rewards, unlock new crops, animals, and processing buildings, and grow your farm from a humble patch into a bustling business.

🌊 Order Waves & Time-Limited Challenges
Take on exciting “Order Waves,” where you’ll race to fulfill multiple orders within a time limit—testing your strategy and keeping you on your toes.

🏡 Relaxing Yet Rewarding
Whether you're casually farming or optimizing your production chain, every merge and every coin feels satisfying. With a charming art style and easy-to-learn mechanics, Relaxing Farm: Merge Tales is the perfect game to unwind and feel accomplished.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced with a mouse; optimized for 16:9 display ratio.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Supports both windowed and fullscreen modes.
